items.headline: High Wind Watch issued September 23 at 2:55AM AKDT until September 26 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 50 mph with gusts up to 70 mph possible.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp and Windy Pass.

* WHEN...From Thursday evening through Saturday evening.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds could blow around unsecured objects. Travel
could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
items.areas: Northern Denali Borough; Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 22 at 2:18PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
We are currently tracking a low that is expected to move through
the southern Bering Sea Thursday through Saturday and which could
approach the coast of the Yukon Delta. While the most likely
storm track south of our area would result in only modest rises in
above normal high water for the Yukon Delta, a further north
track could result in high surf potential. As of right now, the
southern portion of the Yukon Delta coast could see water levels

items.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued September 22 at 1:36PM AKDT until September 26 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels on average of 1 to 2 feet above the normal
highest tide line. Southeast winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to
60 mph expected Thursday. South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts to
50 mph expected Friday.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast including Kwigillingok and Kipnuk.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Thursday to 4 AM Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Coastal flooding of low lying areas and erosion are
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...There will be multiple peaks in water
levels for the Kuskokwim Delt
items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
items.instruction:
A coastal flood watch means that conditions favorable for
flooding are expected to develop. Coastal residents should be
alert for later statements or warnings, and take action to
protect property.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued September 22 at 1:03PM AKDT until September 24 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 45 to 65 mph with gusts up to 80 mph expected.

* WHERE...Atka and Adak.

* WHEN...From 7 AM to 10 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind. Prepare for the possibility of widespread
power outages. Use caution if you must drive.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued September 22 at 12:43PM AKDT until September 26 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Interior Kuskokwim Delta, including Kwethluk, Kasigluk,
Bethel, Napaskiak, Napakiak, Oscarville, and other nearby villages.

* WHEN...Through Saturday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive rain in combination of persistent high water
levels and storm surge may result in flooding of rivers, creeks,
streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations. Creeks and
streams may rise out of their banks. Low-water crossings may be
